issue.title: Credential-bearing browser proof drifted onto main without the patched Chrome floor

wfm_evidence.latest_railway_run_outcome: failed before Chrome spawn because ffmpeg was unavailable
wfm_evidence.reason_no_browser_exposure_in_latest_run: The live visual evidence module asserted ffmpeg availability before spawning Chrome or submitting the staging password to the browser. Earlier non-browser authenticated API proofs in the same job did use the staging credential directly from Node, but the stale browser did not receive it in this run.
wfm_evidence.latent_exposure: The main live-browser workflow could still inject WFM_DEMO_PASSWORD into the system Chrome when manually dispatched or when its workflow changes, and the Railway visual-evidence path would have done the same once its unrelated ffmpeg blocker was removed. Neither main path enforced the Chrome security floor before this bounded fix.

impact_and_exploitability.classification: No verified customer production compromise; high-value staging/demo credential exposure path existed if a credential-bearing browser proof executed on the stale runner.
impact_and_exploitability.exploitability: Requires execution of a credential-bearing browser proof on a runner below the patched Chrome floor plus exploitation of a browser vulnerability or browser compromise. The observed runner image is the same stale image measured at Chrome 152.0.7977.82, below 153.0.8010.47.

actions: centralize the minimum Chrome version in a machine-readable browser security-floor policy
fail before WFM_DEMO_PASSWORD is injected into the live browser workflow
fail before RAILWAY_TOKEN is injected or WFM_STAGING_PASSWORD is retrieved by the Railway proof workflow
recheck the same floor inside live-visual-evidence before Chrome is spawned
disallow generic unverified Chromium fallback in the credential-bearing floor checker
add a CI prevention gate that asserts version-comparator boundaries and secret-step ordering

regression.stale_runner_expected: The workflow terminates at the Chrome preflight, before any browser-relevant secret-bearing step.
regression.stale_runner_observed: Run 35254740346 denied Chrome 152.0.7977.82, then skipped browser driver installation and the WFM_DEMO_PASSWORD authenticated journey.
regression.patched_runner_expected: Only a runner at or above the recorded security floor may proceed to the credential-bearing proof; all existing tenant, fixture-only, verification and rollback boundaries remain unchanged.

next_action: Keep draft PR 41 unmerged and do not bypass the floor. Re-run the authenticated browser proof only when the hosted runner meets Chrome 153.0.8010.47 or later, or an integrity-verified patched browser is introduced through the existing gates.
